q1.question: Is Athlifyr really free?
q1.answer: Yes, 100% free. There are no subscription fees, no hidden charges and no credit card required. All features — gym management, event creation, live race tracking — are included at no cost.

q2.question: How does Athlifyr make money?
q2.answer: Athlifyr generates revenue through a small processing fee on event registrations paid by athletes, not by venue owners. Gym and studio management is completely free with no transaction fees.

q3.question: Will Athlifyr become paid in the future?
q3.answer: No. Our core platform — gym management, event discovery, and community features — will remain free forever. We are committed to making sports management accessible to everyone.

q4.question: What is included in the free plan?
q4.answer: Everything. Client management, class scheduling, trial class bookings, subscription management, coach management, WOD publishing, event creation, live race tracking, community feed, multi-language support and more.

q5.question: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
q5.answer: No. You can create your account and start using Athlifyr immediately with no payment information required.

q6.question: How much does it cost to list my gym on Athlifyr?
q6.answer: Nothing. Listing your gym, CrossFit box, yoga studio or any fitness venue on Athlifyr is completely free. You get full access to all management tools at zero cost.
